note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit changed only in how the VPN family is named (family.Family{AFIIPv4, SAFIFlowSpecVPN} instead of the plugin constant). RFC 5575 Section 8: "The NLRI length field shall include both the 8 bytes of the Route Distinguisher as well as the subsequent flow specification." TestFlowSpecVPNUpdateCountsRouteDistinguisher builds a VPN UPDATE through the real message builder and requires the exact MP_REACH NLRI 13|RD|5-octet value (red on a length of 5) with SAFI 134, re-parses it, and requires the core ParseFlowSpecVPN to error when the length octet is reduced by 8.
